description: Fetch and execute a remote skill on-the-fly without installing it permanently. Use when the user wants to try a skill once, run a skill from GitHub, use a remote skill without installing, or mentions "use-remote-skill", "run remote skill", "try this skill", "fetch skill", "one-time skill", or provides a GitHub URL/shorthand pointing to a skill they want to execute. This is the go-to skill whenever someone wants to use a skill they haven't installed locally. Also use when the user mentions skills.sh or wants to search for available skills.
